practiceOrFeature: Repeating an intense somatic release practice after a calm first session
observation: Synthetic pilot reports show that a calm immediate response did not reliably predict the following two or three days. Repeated intense practice before delayed effects were known sometimes coincided with agitation, exhaustion, or sleep disruption.
contexts: All reports involved an intense rather than gentle practice.
Three people repeated the practice within 24 hours.
confounders: Practice intensity was self-described rather than standardized.
Two contributors also had stressful life events that week.
adverseSignals: Three synthetic reports describe delayed worsening.
Two describe sleep disruption beginning after the immediate calm period.
One describes exhaustion lasting more than two days.
unknowns: The reports are synthetic examples, not participant evidence.
External evidence has not been checked.
